stages.note_ja: リードスクリューを準備済みのアンチバックラッシュナットに通します。2分割ナットは説明書の組立参照に従います。表示は元CADの組立位置で、挿入動作やねじ山の噛合を認定するものではありません。

stages.title: Loosely fasten the Z motor to the frame
stages.title_ja: Zモーターをフレームに仮止め
stages.note: Fit all four original M3x8 frame screws to the same preloaded motor-mount nuts. Leave these four screws loose for the following alignment operation. The two M3x8 motor-case screws are different original occurrences.
stages.note_ja: 元のフレーム固定用M3x8を4本と、先入れ済みの同じモーター取付ナットを使います。次の整列が終わるまで4本を完全には締めません。モーター本体側のM3x8を2本とは別の元CAD項目です。

stages.title: Lower the bed and loosen the two nut-holder screws
stages.title_ja: ベッドを最下部にしてナット固定ネジ2本を緩める
stages.note: In the physical build, turn the leadscrew to bring the bed fully down. Loosen only the same two top M3x12 nut-holder screws prepared on page92. The four motor-to-frame screws remain loose. The static source view does not reproduce that bottom-position adjustment.
stages.note_ja: 実機ではリードスクリューを回してベッドを最下部へ下げます。92ページで使った同じ上側M3x12を2本だけ緩めます。モーターとフレームの4本も緩めたままです。この静的な元CAD表示は、最下部での調整姿勢までは再現しません。

stages.title: Center the leadscrew and tighten the original screws
stages.title_ja: リードスクリューを中心に合わせて同じネジを固定
stages.note: Keep the bed fully down. Position the motor approximately midway between the two Z rails and tighten the four M3x8 motor-to-frame screws first. Then re-tighten or reinsert the same two top M3x12 nut-holder screws loosened on the previous page. No new screws are introduced.
stages.note_ja: ベッドを最下部に保ち、モーターを2本のZレール間のおおよそ中央へ合わせます。先にフレーム固定用M3x8を4本締め、その後、前工程で緩めたホルダー上側の同じM3x12を2本締め直すか、入れ直して固定します。新しいネジは追加しません。

stages.title: Check the Z travel by manually cycling the bed
stages.title_ja: ベッドを手動で往復させてZ動作を確認
stages.note: Manually cycle the bed through its range and check for resistance. Follow the manual if real hardware binds; a displayed source pose does not certify free travel, alignment or clearance.
stages.note_ja: 実機のベッドを手動で全行程往復させ、抵抗を確認します。引っ掛かる場合は説明書に従って調整してください。元CADの表示だけで自由な動き、整列、クリアランスを認定することはできません。

stages.title: Fit the left XY joint inserts
stages.title_ja: 左XYジョイントにインサートを入れる
stages.note: Fit the two original heat-set inserts slightly below the printed surface. Set this body aside while building the bearing stack.
stages.note_ja: 元の熱圧入インサート2個を、印刷部品の表面より少し低く入れます。この部品はベアリングの重ね組みが終わるまで別に置きます。

stages.title: Build the left XY bearing stacks upside down
stages.title_ja: 左XYジョイントを逆さに重ね組み
stages.note: Use the matching printed plate, two M3x25 screws, four F623 bearings, eight shims and the original spacers. Keep the illustrated mirrored bearing levels.
stages.note_ja: 対応する印刷部品、M3x25を2本、F623ベアリング4個、シム8枚と元のスペーサーを使います。左右でベアリング高さが逆になる説明図を確認します。

stages.title: Close the left XY joint
stages.title_ja: 左XYジョイントを閉じる
stages.note: Bring back the same body with its two inserts and fit the original M2x10 self-tapping screw. Keep the two mirrored joint bodies on their specified sides.
stages.note_ja: インサート2個を入れた同じ部品を戻し、元のM2x10タッピングネジを取り付けます。左右のジョイント部品を取り違えないようにします。

stages.title: Check the left XY joint internal gap
stages.title_ja: 左XYジョイントの内寸を確認
stages.note: Check the illustrated 19 mm gap between the two inner printed faces. The complete prepared joint stays aside until it is attached to the X extrusion.
stages.note_ja: 内側の印刷面どうしの間隔が、説明図の19 mmになっていることを確認します。組み終えたジョイントは、X押出材へ取り付けるまで別に置きます。

stages.title: Fit the right XY joint inserts
stages.title_ja: 右XYジョイントにインサートを入れる
stages.note: Fit the two original heat-set inserts slightly below the printed surface. Set this body aside while building the bearing stack.
stages.note_ja: 元の熱圧入インサート2個を、印刷部品の表面より少し低く入れます。この部品はベアリングの重ね組みが終わるまで別に置きます。

stages.title: Build the right XY bearing stacks upside down
stages.title_ja: 右XYジョイントを逆さに重ね組み
stages.note: Use the matching printed plate, two M3x25 screws, four F623 bearings, eight shims and the original spacers. Keep the illustrated mirrored bearing levels.
stages.note_ja: 対応する印刷部品、M3x25を2本、F623ベアリング4個、シム8枚と元のスペーサーを使います。左右でベアリング高さが逆になる説明図を確認します。

stages.title: Close the right XY joint
stages.title_ja: 右XYジョイントを閉じる
stages.note: Bring back the same body with its two inserts and fit the original M2x10 self-tapping screw. Keep the two mirrored joint bodies on their specified sides.
stages.note_ja: インサート2個を入れた同じ部品を戻し、元のM2x10タッピングネジを取り付けます。左右のジョイント部品を取り違えないようにします。

stages.title: Check the right XY joint internal gap
stages.title_ja: 右XYジョイントの内寸を確認
stages.note: Check the illustrated 19 mm gap between the two inner printed faces. The complete prepared joint stays aside until it is attached to the X extrusion.
stages.note_ja: 内側の印刷面どうしの間隔が、説明図の19 mmになっていることを確認します。組み終えたジョイントは、X押出材へ取り付けるまで別に置きます。

stages.title: Mount the X rail and preload joint nuts
stages.note: Reuse the prepared fifth nut carrier. Centre the X rail at the illustrated 25 mm end offset and preload the joint slots. Keep the carriage captive. All six source XY-joint nuts are retained here.

stages.title: Attach XY joints loosely to the X extrusion
stages.note: Keep all six extrusion fixing screws loose until the XY joints meet the Y carriages; check the mirrored bearing levels. Sensorless X/Y setup is outside this static map.

stages.title: Attach the gantry to the Y carriages
stages.note: Spread joints outward at the rear position, then attach all eight countersunk rail-carriage screws.

stages.title: Square and check the gantry
stages.note: Move rearward against both drives before tightening the six joint screws, then check free front-to-back travel and derack if necessary. This is a manual check, not an automated clearance pass.

stages.title: Install the two upper side members
stages.title_ja: 上側の横材2本を取り付け
stages.note: Use the two original B frame members with their preloaded nuts. Keep the front and rear M3x10 screws for the following operations.
stages.note_ja: 先入れナットを入れた元のB横材2本を使います。前後のM3x10は、続く固定工程で使います。

stages.title: Remove both cam locks for screw access
stages.title_ja: ネジを締めるため両カムロックを外す
stages.note: Temporarily remove both original cam locks as shown. Set them aside for refitting after the front screws.
stages.note_ja: 説明書どおり両方の元カムロックを一時的に外します。前側のネジを締めた後、同じ部品を戻します。

stages.title: Fasten the front ends of the upper members
stages.title_ja: 上側横材の前端をネジで固定
stages.note: Install the two original front M3x10 screws while the cam locks are removed.
stages.note_ja: カムロックを外した状態で、元の前側M3x10を2本取り付けます。

stages.title: Refit the same two cam locks
stages.title_ja: 同じカムロック2個を戻す
stages.note: Refit both cam locks removed in the preceding operation; these are the same original parts.
stages.note_ja: 前の工程で外した、同じ元カムロック2個を戻します。

stages.title: Fasten the rear ends of the upper members
stages.title_ja: 上側横材の後端をネジで固定
stages.note: Install the two original rear M3x10 screws through the drive housings into the upper frame members.
stages.note_ja: 元の後側M3x10を2本、ドライブハウジングから上側横材へ取り付けます。

stages.title: Prepare the X carriage and retained captive hardware
stages.note: Remove the built-in print support before use. The r1 source exports it as a separate leaf; the V0.2 carriage is a composite source leaf. Support is retained in inventory only and must not be treated as installed hardware.

stages.title: Fit the MakerBeam belt clamps loosely
stages.note: Match FHCS length convention and leave clamps loose for threading. Start with equal belt lengths; slacken drive tensioners before routing.

stages.title: Route the lower A belt
stages.note: A is below B. Follow the complete manual route; belt contact belongs on bearing races and pulley teeth, not printed bodies. Only the final routed belt mesh appears here.

stages.title: Route the upper B belt
stages.note: B is above A. Secure equal tooth-tail counts without final trimming yet; avoid plastic contact. The map does not simulate threading or tension.

stages.title: Fasten the carriage to the X rail block
stages.note: Use the four source carriage screws with a small metal-only threadlocker application; excess threadlocker can damage ABS.

stages.title: Equalize belt tension and trim tails
stages.note: Use the manual 110 Hz reference at the indicated 150 mm spans with the gantry rearward. Equalize both belts before final trimming; tail clearance depends on the hotend.

stages.title: Prepare the bed adjustment knobs
stages.note: Install the three knob inserts. The two drag-chain spacer inserts were assigned in early bed-carrier preparation.

stages.title: Orient the build plate
stages.note: The single mounting hole faces front and counterbores face upward.

stages.title: Apply the magnetic sheet
stages.note: Clean and press the adhesive sheet onto the plate; keep mounting-screw access available. Final CAD adhesion is shown without an ingress animation.

stages.title: Apply the bed heater
stages.note: Clean the plate and centre the heater on its underside. The displayed plate remains at its final pose rather than flipping through installed parts.

stages.title: Review the thermal fuse protection
stages.note: r1 describes an inline fuse attached to the heater pad with RTV. No separate fuse leaf or wiring is identifiable in this export; protection remains unverified.

stages.title: Install and lock bed mounting bolts
stages.note: Lock the three bolts against rotation with their nuts and washers. Alternative bed frames require their own bolt-length and Z-clearance review.

stages.title: Install the sprung bed and flex plate
stages.note: Fit the three bed springs and adjustment knobs to the stock carrier. The flex plate is a source build-surface layer, not a separately illustrated new assembly instruction.

stages.title: Route and secure bed wires
stages.note: Route individual heater and thermistor wires through the nut-block guide and tie loops. The export does not supply a complete wiring harness; wire separation and flex clearance remain unverified.

stages.title: Reconnect the bed drag chain
stages.note: Reuse both end connectors and reconnect the eleven source links. At the highest bed position the chain must stay below the Z extrusion tops so the gantry can pass; static geometry does not certify a swept envelope.

stages.title: Prepare cowling inserts
stages.title_ja: カウリングのインサートを準備
stages.note: Prepare the three cowling inserts.

stages.title: Prepare the shuttle insert
stages.title_ja: シャトルのインサートを準備
stages.note: Fit the shuttle insert as shown in the manual.

stages.title: Prepare both strain-relief spacers
stages.title_ja: 配線保持用スペーサー2本を準備
stages.note: Prepare four end inserts in the two spacers, then keep both spacers aside until strain-relief installation.

stages.title: Prepare midbody inserts and stop screw
stages.title_ja: ミッドボディのインサートと調整ネジを準備
stages.note: Fit five inserts and start the M2x6 stop screw in the plastic. This same screw is adjusted later.

stages.title: Recheck the prepared X-carriage inserts
stages.title_ja: 準備済みXキャリッジのインサートを再確認
stages.note: Reuse the carriage and its two inserts prepared earlier.

stages.title: Prepare the guidler and BMG idler
stages.title_ja: ガイドラーとBMGアイドラーを準備
stages.note: Follow the manual support-removal diagram before fitting the idler bearings, shaft and reinforcing screw.

stages.title: Check the shaft and both gear bearings
stages.title_ja: ギヤ軸と2個のベアリングを確認
stages.note: Check that the short shaft end protrudes less than 3 mm. Test-fit both MR85 bearings, then remove them for assembly.

stages.title: Prepare the motor plate bearing and captive nut
stages.title_ja: モータープレートのベアリングとナットを準備
stages.note: Secure the captive M3 nut as instructed, keeping adhesive away from its threads and the bearing. Set the prepared plate aside.

stages.title: Seat the front gear-shaft bearing
stages.title_ja: 前側のギヤ軸ベアリングを取り付け

stages.title: Fit the prepared shuttle
stages.title_ja: 準備したシャトルを組み込む

stages.title: Fit the prepared guidler
stages.title_ja: 準備したガイドラーを組み込む

stages.title: Fit the latch
stages.title_ja: ラッチを組み込む

stages.title: Join the midbody and pivot fasteners
stages.title_ja: ミッドボディと軸用ネジを取り付け
stages.note: Use three M3x25 screws and both lower M3x10 screws. The lower M3x25 is the guidler hinge; keep the arm moving freely.

stages.title: Fit the drive gear on the 50T shaft
stages.title_ja: 50T軸にドライブギヤを取り付け
stages.note: Follow the reversed gear orientation in the diagram. Leave the grub screw loose until filament alignment.

stages.title: Close the extruder with the prepared motor plate
stages.title_ja: 準備したモータープレートで押出機を閉じる
stages.note: Reuse the prepared plate, bearing and captive nut. Use two M3x6 screws and the separate lower-side M3x10 screw.

stages.title: Check the 50T gear side clearance
stages.title_ja: 50Tギヤの横すきまを確認
stages.note: Centre the 50T gear with about 0.75 mm side clearance as illustrated.

stages.title: Align the drive teeth with the filament path
stages.title_ja: ドライブギヤの歯をフィラメント経路に合わせる
stages.note: Use filament to align the drive teeth, then secure the grub screw against the shaft flat.

stages.title: Fit the tension screw and spring
stages.title_ja: テンションネジとばねを取り付け
stages.note: Follow the manual screw, spring and washer arrangement. The washer is not a separately identified part in this source model.

stages.title: Check latch engagement in the shuttle
stages.title_ja: ラッチがシャトルの溝に入ることを確認
stages.note: The latch must engage the groove in the shuttle.

stages.title: Check feeding and the anti-squish stop
stages.title_ja: 送り状態と押しつぶし防止ネジを確認
stages.note: Adjust the same M2 stop screw and check for light tooth marks on the filament before fitting the motor.

stages.title: Fit the first duct blower
stages.title_ja: 片側のブロワーファンを取り付け
stages.note: Orient the blower outlet into the cooling duct and follow the illustrated wire route.

stages.title: Fit the 3010 hotend fan
stages.title_ja: 3010ホットエンドファンを取り付け
stages.note: The 3010 fan blows into the cowling. Follow the illustrated wire exit.

stages.title: Fit the opposite duct blower
stages.title_ja: 反対側のブロワーファンを取り付け
stages.note: Fit the opposite blower and route its wires through the illustrated channel.

stages.title: Source CAD supplement: nozzle LEDs
stages.title_ja: 元CAD補足：ノズルLED
stages.note: Optional source CAD supplement. This manual section does not describe its installation.

stages.title: Start the motor fixing at the round hole
stages.title_ja: モーターを丸穴側で仮止めする
stages.note: Fit the motor and slightly tighten the M3x10 screw at the round hole.

stages.title: Fit the motor adjustment-slot screw loosely
stages.title_ja: モーター調整用の長穴側を仮止めする
stages.note: Keep the M3x10 in the curved slot loose until gear backlash is set. Its rear threads are also used for the strain-relief spacer.

stages.title: Open the latch and guidler for adjustment
stages.title_ja: 調整のためラッチとガイドラーを開く
stages.note: Open the latch and guidler on the real assembly so the 50T gear can turn freely. The reference model does not animate this joint.

stages.title: Adjust the motor gear backlash
stages.title_ja: モーターのギヤの遊びを調整
stages.note: Adjust the motor through the slot and check gear play through a complete turn, as described in the manual.

stages.title: Tighten and repeat the feeding check
stages.title_ja: モーターを固定して送り状態を再確認
stages.note: Tighten the same two motor screws, then repeat the gear-play and filament checks.

stages.title: Check the source hotend choice
stages.title_ja: 元モデルのホットエンドを確認
stages.note: This source assembly uses Revo Voron. Other hotends need their own matching mount and hardware.

stages.title: Assemble the source Revo Voron hotend
stages.title_ja: 元モデルのRevo Voronを組み立て
stages.note: Use the matching Revo Voron mount and all four M3x8 screws.

stages.title: Insert the source PTFE tube
stages.title_ja: 元モデルのPTFEチューブを入れる

stages.title: Check the captured PTFE protrusion
stages.title_ja: PTFEの突き出し6 mmを確認
stages.note: The PTFE tube must project 6 mm above the mount and remain captured by the hotend.

stages.title: Trim PTFE using the official jig method
stages.title_ja: 公式治具の方法でPTFEを切りそろえる
stages.note: Seat the tube fully, then use the official pulley jig to trim it flush. The jig is not included in this model.

stages.title: Join the hotend and cowling
stages.title_ja: ホットエンドとカウリングを固定
stages.note: Join the prepared hotend and cowling with the two M3x35 front screws.

stages.title: Mount the toolhead with the front fixings
stages.title_ja: 前側のネジでヘッドをキャリッジに取り付け
stages.note: Reuse those same two long front screws to mount the head on the carriage. Keep the lower M3x10 screws in place.

stages.title: Fit the rear carriage screw
stages.title_ja: 後側のキャリッジ固定ネジを取り付け
stages.note: Use the rear M3x16 screw with the captive nut in the motor plate.

stages.title: Install the prepared strain-relief parts
stages.title_ja: 準備した配線保持部品を取り付け
stages.note: Fit the prepared spacers on the exposed motor-screw threads, then add the strain-relief plate and its four screws.

stages.title: Secure the wire bundle at the tie loops
stages.title_ja: 結束部で配線束を固定
stages.note: Secure the wires at the illustrated tie points on the head and strain relief. The full wire bundle is not modeled.

stages.title: Separate heater and thin-wire routes
stages.title_ja: ヒーター線と細い配線の経路を分ける
stages.note: Allow only the needed slack with the head at the front. Route heater wires separately from thin sensor and fan wires.

stages.title: Source CAD supplement: generic ADXL assembly
stages.title_ja: 元CAD補足：汎用ADXL一式
stages.note: Optional source CAD supplement. This manual section does not describe its installation.

stages.title: Align the mid panel with the preloaded nuts
stages.title_ja: ミッドパネルと先入れナットの位置を合わせる
stages.note: Use the six nuts preloaded into the inner uprights. The official guide shows turning the printer for access; this reference does not simulate a flip.

stages.title: Secure the mid panel with six M3x6 screws
stages.title_ja: M3×6ネジ6本でミッドパネルを固定
stages.note: Reuse the original six preloaded M3 nuts; do not add a second set. The two unused holes are for the optional Bowden extruder shown in the manual.
stages.note_ja: 先入れした元のM3ナット6個を使い、追加しません。残る2つの穴は、マニュアルにある別構成のボーデンエクストルーダー用です。

stages.title: Prepare the fan mount with four inserts
stages.title_ja: ファン取付部にインサート4個を準備
stages.note: Prepare the four original threaded inserts in the lower fan mount as shown in the official heat-set diagram. Keep the prepared subassembly aside until the fan-mount installation.

stages.title: Prepare both board mounts and DIN clips
stages.title_ja: 2組の基板固定台とDINクリップを組む
stages.note: Fit each source DIN clip with two M2x10 self-tapping screws. The eight board screws are used after the purchased boards are in place.

stages.title: Check the mount height and selected holes
stages.title_ja: 固定台の高さと使う穴を確認
stages.note: The manual allows selecting mounting holes for board height. This source reference retains its captured hole positions.

stages.title: Apply tape to both DIN cleats
stages.title_ja: 2個のDINクリートにテープを貼る
stages.note: Use the captured DIN-clip and taped-cleat branch. The manual also describes direct tape mounting as an alternative; it is not substituted here.

stages.title: Position the taped cleats on the mid panel
stages.title_ja: テープを貼ったクリートをパネルに取り付け
stages.note: Confirm the board positions before sticking down the cleats.

stages.title: Clip the prepared mounts onto the cleats
stages.title_ja: 準備した固定台をクリートに取り付け
stages.note: Use the prepared mounts. The manual illustrates engagement direction; this reference changes display state without simulating a snap path.

stages.title: Place the complete SKR Pico board
stages.title_ja: SKR Pico基板を固定台に載せる
stages.note: Treat the purchased board as one assembly. Its source components are references, not soldering instructions.

stages.title: Fasten the SKR Pico with four M2x10 screws
stages.title_ja: M2×10ネジ4本でSKR Picoを固定
stages.note: Use the four board-attachment screws from this source owner.

stages.title: Place the complete Raspberry Pi board
stages.title_ja: Raspberry Piを固定台に載せる
stages.note: Keep the source Raspberry Pi assembly complete.

stages.title: Fasten the Raspberry Pi with four M2x10 screws
stages.title_ja: M2×10ネジ4本でRaspberry Piを固定
stages.note: Use the four board-attachment screws from this source owner.

stages.title: Review both mounted boards
stages.title_ja: 2枚の基板の固定を確認
stages.note: Check the two source board assemblies and their separate fasteners. Wiring and electrical checks follow in the official guide.

stages.title: Check the supply model and input-voltage selector
stages.title_ja: 電源の型番と入力電圧の設定を確認
stages.note: The official diagram locates an input-voltage selector where fitted. Check the exact supply and manufacturer documentation; this source model has no electrical selector state.

stages.title: Check the power-supply position and mounting method
stages.title_ja: 電源の固定位置と方法を確認
stages.note: The guide specifies a 1–2 mm body-to-frame gap and shows adhesive mounting or an alternative with two M3x6 screws and drilled holes. This original CAD position and its unmodeled adhesive/alternative fasteners are not a qualified mounting.

stages.title: Fit the upper fan support to the frame
stages.title_ja: ファンの上側支持部をフレームに取り付け
stages.note: Place the original upper support on the illustrated rear frame rail. Follow the orientation in the manual.

stages.title: Position the prepared lower fan mount
stages.title_ja: 準備したファン取付部を合わせる
stages.note: Bring back the lower mount and its four prepared inserts. Align it with the upper support shown in the previous operation.

stages.title: Fasten the mount with two M3x12 screws
stages.title_ja: M3×12ネジ2本で取付部を固定
stages.note: Use the two original M3x12 BHCS fasteners for the mount. The M3x16 screws are reserved for the fan.

stages.title: Position the complete 3010 cooling fan
stages.title_ja: 3010ファンを取り付け位置に合わせる
stages.note: Keep the purchased 3010 fan complete and follow the illustrated orientation. Its internal geometry is a source reference.

stages.title: Fasten the fan with two M3x16 screws
stages.title_ja: M3×16ネジ2本でファンを固定
stages.note: Use the two original M3x16 BHCS fasteners through the fan into their own inserts.

stages.title: Review the controller cooling fan
stages.title_ja: 制御基板冷却ファンの組立を確認
stages.note: Review the two mount halves, four inserts, two screw lengths and complete fan against the official diagram. This reference retains the source positions; no insertion path is simulated.

stages.title: Disconnect power before wiring work
stages.title_ja: 配線前に電源を切り離す
stages.note: Follow the official power-off checks before wiring. This viewer does not determine whether the real machine can be energized.

stages.title: Distinguish AC, protective earth and DC
stages.title_ja: AC・保護接地・DCを区別して確認
stages.note: Check the official diagram for L/N/PE and V+/V-. Protective earth and controller GND are different references; do not identify a connection solely by wire color.

stages.title: Check the mains-inlet wiring diagram
stages.title_ja: インレットの配線図を確認
stages.note: The official page shows the separate inlet wiring before installation. Mains work requires personnel qualified under local rules. The source inlet remains a complete purchased unit; wire lengths, terminals, routing and electrical checks are not represented as completed.

stages.title: Locate the complete inlet in its printed foot
stages.title_ja: インレットを足部の取付位置に合わせる
stages.note: Compare the complete inlet and its own printed receiving foot with the official diagram. This is source placement reference; a snap-in path, engagement and retention have not been established.

stages.title: Check the mains connections and wire retention
stages.title_ja: AC側の接続と配線の保持を確認
stages.note: Use the exact official inlet-to-supply diagram and retain the wires as shown. A terminal cover follows later. This model contains no qualified external harness, terminals or protective-earth continuity test.

stages.title: Check DC power and controller-fan connections
stages.title_ja: DC電源と基板冷却ファンの接続を確認
stages.note: Use this edition of the official diagram for supply, board and controller fan. The V0.2 and r1 printed cross-section entries differ; do not silently treat the mm²/AWG text as an electrical equivalence or validated cable selection.

stages.title: Identify the heaters, thermistors and fans
stages.title_ja: ヒーター・サーミスタ・ファンを確認
stages.note: The official diagram assumes 24V cooling fans. Verify actual device ratings and identities rather than using colors alone. The source head fans are identifiable, while physical external harness and heater/thermistor terminal correspondence remain open.

stages.title: Compare the A, B, Z and E motor positions
stages.title_ja: A・B・Z・Eモーターの位置を照合
stages.note: The official drawing identifies B as X and A as Y. Compare these with their exact source drive assemblies and the Z/E motors. Do not infer electrical phase or pin assignment from motor wire colors.

stages.title: Use the diagram for the actual SKR Pico board
stages.title_ja: SKR Picoの配線図と照合
stages.note: Keep the source SKR Pico complete. Compare the X/Y DIAG and device connections with the official Pico diagram; the E3 V3 diagram is a different board. No individual CAD connector-to-pin mapping or wiring is yet qualified. This r1 diagram additionally labels a filament sensor; the earlier edition must not inherit that connection silently.

stages.title: Check Pi power and the selected communication option
stages.title_ja: Piの電源と通信方式を確認
stages.note: The guide distinguishes USB/UART and shows a separate E3 V3 power alternative. Do not substitute that board or a generic converter into this Pico source assembly. Pi power, cable and firmware configuration require the exact selected hardware.

stages.title: Position the supply terminal guard after wiring checks
stages.title_ja: 配線確認後に端子カバーを合わせる
stages.note: The official guard reduces accidental terminal contact. Its displayed source position does not certify electrical safety, retention or whole-machine clearance.

stages.title: Position the right skirt
stages.title_ja: 右のスカートを位置に合わせる
stages.note: Keep the original printed source geometry and align with the manual view. Source placement is a reference; finite mounting/retention is not yet qualified. This r1 page also permits fitting screws to the extrusion first, then sliding the slotted skirt on before tightening. That alternative is not animated or assumed in the earlier edition.

stages.title: Check the right skirt fasteners
stages.title_ja: 右スカートの固定ねじを確認
stages.note: The manual specifies 4 M3x6 BHCS. Source instances remain distinct; their modeled shank/head and receiving slots/nuts still require finite native checks. This is not a tightening or insertion-path simulation.

stages.title: Position the left skirt
stages.title_ja: 左のスカートを位置に合わせる
stages.note: Keep the original printed source geometry and align with the manual view. Source placement is a reference; finite mounting/retention is not yet qualified.

stages.title: Check the left skirt fasteners
stages.title_ja: 左スカートの固定ねじを確認
stages.note: The manual specifies 4 M3x6 BHCS. Source instances remain distinct; their modeled shank/head and receiving slots/nuts still require finite native checks. This is not a tightening or insertion-path simulation.

stages.title: Position the rear skirt
stages.title_ja: 背面のスカートを位置に合わせる
stages.note: Keep the original printed source geometry and align with the manual view. Source placement is a reference; finite mounting/retention is not yet qualified.

stages.title: Check the rear skirt fasteners
stages.title_ja: 背面スカートの固定ねじを確認
stages.note: The manual specifies 2 M3x6 BHCS. Source instances remain distinct; their modeled shank/head and receiving slots/nuts still require finite native checks. This is not a tightening or insertion-path simulation. The diagram specifies access with a 2 mm ball-end driver.

stages.title: Prepare the left front skirt and logo
stages.title_ja: 左前スカートにロゴを合わせる
stages.note: The manual presses the original logo into its own front skirt. Glue is optional, not required. Source positions are retained; interference/press fit and holding remain open.

stages.title: Prepare the right front skirt and logo
stages.title_ja: 右前スカートにロゴを合わせる
stages.note: Keep this separate prepared half aside until both halves return to the frame. Do not replace either original logo or anonymous source body.

stages.title: Position the two front skirt halves
stages.title_ja: 前スカートの左右を足部に合わせる
stages.note: The diagram aligns the halves with the feet and leaves the center open for the display. Exact receiving-foot linkage and finite fit remain open. The source display blank is a separate native-excluded alternative.

stages.title: Check the four front skirt fasteners
stages.title_ja: 前スカートの4本の固定ねじを確認
stages.note: The manual specifies four M3x6 BHCS for both halves. Do not invent new screws or mark finite receiving engagement as reviewed.

stages.title: Source alternative: display blank insert
stages.note: This blank is the manual no-display alternative. Do not display it simultaneously with the installed display faceplate. Inventory only when excluded by the native variant mask; excluded parts stay hidden.

stages.title: Prepare the display faceplate and diffuser
stages.title_ja: ディスプレイの表板と拡散板を合わせる
stages.note: The diagram prepares the separate display before frame installation. Keep both exact original printed leaves; no insertion path or clearance is certified.

stages.title: Place the complete display board and its mounts
stages.title_ja: ディスプレイ基板と取付足を合わせる
stages.note: Keep the purchased PCB as its complete seven-solid source leaf. The r1 original mounts are one source leaf containing two solids; do not invent or split a second leaf. Finite screw/receiver correspondence remains open.

stages.title: Check the four M2x10 self-tapping screws
stages.title_ja: 4本のM2x10タッピングねじを確認
stages.note: The diagram specifies four original M2x10 self-tappers. Intended thread cutting must be evaluated separately from unintended body interference; no broad contact exemption is applied.

stages.title: Fit the original encoder knob
stages.title_ja: エンコーダーのノブを合わせる
stages.note: The knob follows the four self-tappers. Keep the exact original knob and complete PCB; source placement does not certify press fit or encoder retention.

stages.title: Return the prepared display to the front
stages.title_ja: 組み立てた表示部を前面に合わせる
stages.note: Return the complete prepared source display to its original frame location. The central display blank remains the excluded alternative; do not show both. Mounting and wire access remain unqualified.

stages.title: Check the two M3x6 display fasteners
stages.title_ja: 表示部を固定する2本のM3x6ねじを確認
stages.note: The diagram specifies two M3x6 BHCS after positioning. Exact original hardware is shown; holding, torque and continuous insertion are not certified.

stages.title: Check the display USB connection route
stages.title_ja: ディスプレイのUSB接続経路を確認
stages.note: The manual offers the side USB port or rear header to the Pi and warns that the connection is fragile. The source has no qualified external cable/pin correspondence; no cable is invented and no wired-complete status is asserted.

stages.title: Locate the four rubber feet before removing them
stages.title_ja: 底面パネルの前に4個のゴム足を外す位置を確認
stages.note: The official drawing removes the four active rubber feet before fitting the bottom panel. This step identifies the original feet; the next panel state sets those same feet aside. No generic feet or removal trajectory are added.

stages.title: Position the bottom panel with the rubber feet set aside
stages.title_ja: ゴム足を外した状態で底面パネルを合わせる
stages.note: The same four original rubber feet are set aside for this manual state only. The four-hole pattern is not a perfect square; the manual suggests checking a 90-degree orientation if holes do not align. This source panel keeps its original pose; no arbitrary rotation or offset is applied to claim fit.

stages.title: Refit the same four rubber feet
stages.title_ja: 同じ4個のゴム足を戻して底面パネルを固定
stages.note: Restore the same four original source feet after positioning the panel. The separate left side-panel clip belongs to the later left-panel step. Original poses return exactly; finite contact, load support and retaining engagement are not certified.

stages.title: Position the printed cable support and its M3x10 screw
stages.title_ja: 配線保持部と対応するM3x10ねじを合わせる
stages.note: The manual places this printed strain-relief part and one M3x10 BHCS before the motor panel. The source part named Cable Tie is the printed bracket, not a nylon zip tie. This screw is no longer shown during front-frame closure. Native screw/receiver engagement remains open.

stages.title: Check the wire and Bowden route before closing the panel
stages.title_ja: パネルを閉じる前に配線束とBowdenの経路を確認
stages.note: Use the official cutout/zip-tie-loop diagram before fastening the motor panel. The original head PTFE segment is a destination reference only; this source has no qualified complete external wire bundle, nylon ties or Bowden route. Do not invent these parts or mark wiring complete.

stages.title: Position the original motor panel
stages.title_ja: 元のモーターパネルを位置に合わせる
stages.note: Position the original source motor panel after the cable-route check. The manual mentions an aftermarket toolhead-board replacement as a separate option; do not substitute that board or certify its mounting from this source panel.

stages.title: Check the two M3x6 motor-panel fasteners
stages.title_ja: モーターパネルのM3x6固定ねじ2本を確認
stages.note: Check the two exact original M3x6 BHCS for the panel. The complete source hardware, original colors and poses are retained. Finite head seats, thread engagement, cable clearance and retention remain open.

stages.title: Prepare the upper PTFE liner
stages.title_ja: 上側のPTFE短管を準備する
stages.note: Fit PTFE only in the upper groove as shown in the manual. This short spool-contact liner is separate from the reverse-Bowden feed tube.

stages.title: Cut the upper liner flush
stages.title_ja: 上側の短管を端面にそろえる
stages.note: Cut the upper PTFE liner flush with the holder surface. The model retains its source length; this view does not simulate cutting or certify the trimmed end.

stages.title: Check the upper M3x12 mounting pair
stages.title_ja: 上側のM3x12固定ねじとナットを確認
stages.note: The manual uses two M3x12 BHCS. This view selects the upper original screw and its matching nut; it does not prescribe a tightening order. Nut seating and tightening remain unverified.

stages.title: Check the lower M3x12 mounting pair
stages.title_ja: 下側のM3x12固定ねじとナットを確認
stages.note: Check the lower original M3x12 screw and its matching nut, together with the holder and upper pair. This source-position view does not certify nut seating or retention.

stages.title: Source CAD: lower PTFE liner
stages.title_ja: 元CADの補足：下側のPTFE短管
stages.note: The manual requires only the upper liner. This lower liner is an additional source-CAD reference, not another required assembly step. Keep it distinct from the 3 mm ID feed tube.

stages.title: Check reverse-Bowden feed requirements
stages.title_ja: 逆Bowdenのチューブ条件を確認
stages.note: Use 3 mm ID PTFE for the reverse-Bowden feed, not FEP. With the sensor foot, use separate short and long pieces. About 250 mm from the motor panel to the head is only a rough length; the short spool liner is a different part. The source model has no full feed tube or verified continuous route.

stages.title: Position both rear panels
stages.title_ja: 上下の後パネルを合わせる
stages.note: Use the 3 mm panels and their original clips. Standard clips do not require VHB tape.

stages.title: Fit the rear panel clips
stages.title_ja: 後パネルのクリップを合わせる
stages.note: Use the 3 mm panels and their original clips. Standard clips do not require VHB tape.

stages.title: Check the rear clip fasteners
stages.title_ja: 後クリップの固定ねじを確認
stages.note: Use the original fasteners assigned to this side; keep left and right clips separate.

stages.title: Position both lower top-hat hinges
stages.title_ja: トップハットの下ヒンジを合わせる
stages.note: The lower top-hat hinges belong on the rear. Align them with the upper hinges at the later attachment step.

stages.title: Check the lower hinge fasteners
stages.title_ja: 下ヒンジの固定ねじを確認
stages.note: The lower top-hat hinges belong on the rear. Align them with the upper hinges at the later attachment step.

stages.title: Position the right side panel
stages.title_ja: 右の透明パネルを合わせる
stages.note: Use the 3 mm panels and their original clips. Standard clips do not require VHB tape.

stages.title: Fit the right panel and hinge clips
stages.title_ja: 右側のクリップとヒンジ受けを合わせる
stages.note: Use the 3 mm panels and their original clips. Standard clips do not require VHB tape.

stages.title: Check the right panel fasteners
stages.title_ja: 右パネルの固定ねじを確認
stages.note: Use the original fasteners assigned to this side; keep left and right clips separate.

stages.title: Position the left side panel
stages.title_ja: 左の透明パネルを合わせる
stages.note: Use the 3 mm panels and their original clips. Standard clips do not require VHB tape.

stages.title: Fit the left panel clips
stages.title_ja: 左側のクリップを合わせる
stages.note: Use the 3 mm panels and their original clips. Standard clips do not require VHB tape.

stages.title: Check the left panel fasteners
stages.title_ja: 左パネルの固定ねじを確認
stages.note: Use the original fasteners assigned to this side; keep left and right clips separate.

stages.title: Prepare both latches and their magnets
stages.title_ja: ラッチ2個と磁石を準備
stages.note: Check attracting magnet orientation before optional glue. The model does not indicate magnetic polarity.

stages.title: Check the latch fasteners
stages.title_ja: ラッチの固定ねじを確認
stages.note: Use the original fasteners assigned to this side; keep left and right clips separate.

stages.title: Prepare the door and its four clips
stages.title_ja: ドアと4個のクリップを準備
stages.note: Attach the four original door clips to the door with VHB tape. Leave the hinge pins for the next step.

stages.title: Fit the upper and lower door pins
stages.title_ja: ドアの上下ヒンジ軸を確認
stages.note: Use the upper M3x40 and lower M3x30 hinge pins shown in the official diagram.

stages.title: Check the lift-off door direction
stages.title_ja: ドアを上へ抜く向きを確認
stages.note: Check that the door lifts upward off its right-side hinges. An insertion or removal path is not simulated.

stages.title: Prepare the handle and matching magnets
stages.title_ja: ハンドルと対応する磁石を準備
stages.note: Check attracting magnet orientation before optional glue. The model does not indicate magnetic polarity.

stages.title: Position the handle on the door
stages.title_ja: ドアにハンドルを合わせる
stages.note: Attach the original handle to the door with VHB tape after checking the matching magnets.

stages.title: Check the handle and latch magnets
stages.title_ja: ハンドルとラッチの磁石を確認
stages.note: Check attracting magnet orientation before optional glue. The model does not indicate magnetic polarity.

stages.title: Prepare the front top-hat beam
stages.title_ja: トップハットの前側横材を準備
stages.note: Prepare this original 200 mm beam with its two M3x10 end screws and the two top-facing and two outward-facing source nuts. Keep the nut slots accessible before closing the frame.

stages.title: Prepare the rear top-hat beam
stages.title_ja: トップハットの後側横材を準備
stages.note: Prepare this original 200 mm beam with its two M3x10 end screws and the two top-facing and two outward-facing source nuts. Keep the nut slots accessible before closing the frame.

stages.title: Prepare the left top-hat beam
stages.title_ja: トップハットの左側横材を準備
stages.note: Prepare this original 200 mm beam with its two M3x10 end screws and the two top-facing and two outward-facing source nuts. Keep the nut slots accessible before closing the frame.

stages.title: Prepare the right top-hat beam
stages.title_ja: トップハットの右側横材を準備
stages.note: Prepare this original 200 mm beam with its two M3x10 end screws and the two top-facing and two outward-facing source nuts. Keep the nut slots accessible before closing the frame.

stages.title: Preload the two front posts
stages.title_ja: 前側の支柱2本にナットを先入れ
stages.note: Preload the original nuts in these two 80 mm posts before closing their slots. The source also includes panel and hinge nuts beyond the schematic callouts.

stages.title: Assemble the front U frame
stages.title_ja: 前側のコの字枠を組み立て
stages.note: Assemble this U frame on a flat surface. Use the access holes and a 2 mm hex driver for its two original M3x10 joint screws.

stages.title: Preload the two rear posts
stages.title_ja: 後側の支柱2本にナットを先入れ
stages.note: Preload the original nuts in these two 80 mm posts before closing their slots. The source also includes panel and hinge nuts beyond the schematic callouts.

stages.title: Assemble the rear U frame
stages.title_ja: 後側のコの字枠を組み立て
stages.note: Assemble this U frame on a flat surface. Use the access holes and a 2 mm hex driver for its two original M3x10 joint screws.

stages.title: Distinguish the front and rear U frames
stages.title_ja: 前後のコの字枠を区別する
stages.note: Distinguish the front U frame from the rear before closing the box. The front posts receive the lock studs; the rear posts receive the hinges.

stages.title: Source CAD: check the two lock studs
stages.title_ja: 元CADのロック用ねじ2本を確認
stages.note: The source has M3x8 studs; the manual specifies M3x10. Check the 5 mm reference separately from screw length.

stages.title: Close the top-hat frame and check squareness
stages.title_ja: トップハット枠を閉じて直角を確認
stages.note: Join the two prepared U frames with the remaining beams on a flat surface. Tighten the four remaining M3x10 joint screws through the access holes and check squareness.

stages.title: Check the front preloaded nuts
stages.title_ja: 前側の先入れナットを確認
stages.note: Check the original preloaded nuts on this side before fitting panels. This includes the source panel and hinge receivers; the schematic callouts are not a complete purchase BOM.

stages.title: Check the right preloaded nuts
stages.title_ja: 右側の先入れナットを確認
stages.note: Check the original preloaded nuts on this side before fitting panels. This includes the source panel and hinge receivers; the schematic callouts are not a complete purchase BOM.

stages.title: Check the rear preloaded nuts
stages.title_ja: 後側の先入れナットを確認
stages.note: Check the original preloaded nuts on this side before fitting panels. This includes the source panel and hinge receivers; the schematic callouts are not a complete purchase BOM.

stages.title: Check the left preloaded nuts
stages.title_ja: 左側の先入れナットを確認
stages.note: Check the original preloaded nuts on this side before fitting panels. This includes the source panel and hinge receivers; the schematic callouts are not a complete purchase BOM.

stages.title: Confirm the preloaded nuts on all four sides
stages.title_ja: 4面すべての先入れナットを再確認
stages.note: Check all four sides and every original preloaded nut before continuing. Slot ownership is a source reference; native seating and holding remain unverified.

stages.title: Position the top-hat top panel
stages.title_ja: トップハットの上面パネルを合わせる
stages.note: Fit the original 3 mm panel and its matching clips. The standard clips do not require VHB tape.

stages.title: Fit the four top panel clips
stages.title_ja: 上面パネルのクリップ4個を合わせる
stages.note: Fit the original 3 mm panel and its matching clips. The standard clips do not require VHB tape.

stages.title: Check the top panel fasteners
stages.title_ja: 上面パネルの固定ねじを確認
stages.note: Use the original M3x8 screws assigned to this panel. Keep the panel clips and their source nuts on the correct side.

stages.title: Position the top-hat front panel
stages.title_ja: トップハットの前面パネルを合わせる
stages.note: Fit the original 3 mm panel and its matching clips. The standard clips do not require VHB tape.

stages.title: Fit the front panel clips
stages.title_ja: 前面パネルのクリップを合わせる
stages.note: Fit the original 3 mm panel and its matching clips. The standard clips do not require VHB tape.

stages.title: Check the front panel fasteners
stages.title_ja: 前面パネルの固定ねじを確認
stages.note: Use the original M3x8 screws assigned to this panel. Keep the panel clips and their source nuts on the correct side.

stages.title: Position the top-hat right panel
stages.title_ja: トップハットの右面パネルを合わせる
stages.note: Fit the original 3 mm panel and its matching clips. The standard clips do not require VHB tape.

stages.title: Fit the right top-hat panel clips
stages.title_ja: トップハット右面のクリップを合わせる
stages.note: Fit the original 3 mm panel and its matching clips. The standard clips do not require VHB tape.

stages.title: Check the right top-hat panel fasteners
stages.title_ja: トップハット右面の固定ねじを確認
stages.note: Use the original M3x8 screws assigned to this panel. Keep the panel clips and their source nuts on the correct side.

stages.title: Position the top-hat left panel
stages.title_ja: トップハットの左面パネルを合わせる
stages.note: Fit the original 3 mm panel and its matching clips. The standard clips do not require VHB tape.

stages.title: Fit the left top-hat panel clips
stages.title_ja: トップハット左面のクリップを合わせる
stages.note: Fit the original 3 mm panel and its matching clips. The standard clips do not require VHB tape.

stages.title: Check the left top-hat panel fasteners
stages.title_ja: トップハット左面の固定ねじを確認
stages.note: Use the original M3x8 screws assigned to this panel. Keep the panel clips and their source nuts on the correct side.

stages.title: Position the top-hat rear panel
stages.title_ja: トップハットの背面パネルを合わせる
stages.note: The rear panel is opposite the two lock studs. Keep the front, rear and side panel clips distinct.

stages.title: Fit the rear top-hat panel clips
stages.title_ja: トップハット背面のクリップを合わせる
stages.note: Fit the original 3 mm panel and its matching clips. The standard clips do not require VHB tape.

stages.title: Check the rear top-hat panel fasteners
stages.title_ja: トップハット背面の固定ねじを確認
stages.note: Use the original M3x8 screws assigned to this panel. Keep the panel clips and their source nuts on the correct side.

stages.title: Fit the upper hinges loosely
stages.title_ja: 上ヒンジを仮止めする
stages.note: Fit the original upper hinges loosely. Their vertical alignment with the lower hinges is finalized at the attachment step; the model retains its source pose.

stages.title: Align the upper and lower top-hat hinges
stages.title_ja: トップハットの上下ヒンジを合わせる
stages.note: Align the upper hinges with the lower hinges before fitting the two M3x12 hinge pins. The source pose is shown; no insertion or adjustment path is simulated.

stages.title: Source CAD: retain the two hinge washers
stages.title_ja: 元CADのヒンジワッシャー2枚を確認
stages.note: These two washers are retained from the source CAD. Show them with the hinge pins; they are not an added manual BOM item.

stages.title: Fit both top-hat hinge pins
stages.title_ja: トップハットのヒンジ軸2本を確認
stages.note: Source CAD placement reference. Insertion paths, tightening and physical fit remain unverified.

stages.title: Check both cam locks are open
stages.title_ja: 両方のカムロックの開放状態を確認
stages.note: Keep both cam locks open before checking top-hat movement so the stud heads can enter. Source contact is unresolved; this view does not animate or certify the opening path.

stages.title: Check the top-hat opening and closing range
stages.title_ja: トップハットの開閉範囲を確認
stages.note: Check smooth opening and closing through the manual range with the locks open. This source-position reference does not certify continuous clearance.

stages.title: Check the clockwise top-hat locking direction
stages.title_ja: トップハットを時計回りにロックする向きを確認
stages.note: After the movement check, turn each cam lock 90 degrees clockwise. The V0.2r1 diagram uses the revised jig feature or a 5 mm hex key; no key is added to the model.

stages.title: Mechanical assembly reference complete
stages.note: Follow the official documentation for electrical checks, configuration and initial startup. Inventory includes source alternatives and optional groups; their union is not a simultaneously buildable or collision-free configuration.
